d:
Jharkhand ke purv mukhyamantri aur vidhanasbha men neta pratipaksh babulal marandi ne dumka men kangres sansad rahul gandhi aur jharkhand ki hemant soren sarkar par ab tak ka sabse tikha rajnitik hamla bola hai.
Dumka men bhartiy janta parti (BJP) dvara aayojit 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' padyatra ke dauran ebipi nyuj se khas batchit men babulal marandi ne rahul gandhi ko 'mansik rup se bimar' batate hue unhen ilaj karane ki salah de dali. unhonne aarop lagaya ki kangres lagatar jhuth aur bhram phailakar desh men arajakta ka mahaul paida karna chahti hai.
